items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Quincy [Jones] was the producer. He‟s the one that hired me. ... For Mercury, correct? Yeah.

ctx.x: It might have been two charts. I don‟t know. I only remember one, which was I Love You and Don‟t You Forget it. Quincy [Jones] was the producer. He‟s the one that hired me.
Yeah. There were no problems. Sarah is never a problem, and the chart was easy.
